title: Šarena Mosque
visualBrief: Individual Šarena Mosque exterior: retained rectangular plan,a columned open porch below an enclosed painted upper gallery,a low brown tiled hip roof with broad colored eaves,four rows of framed cream/green/ochre/rust painted fields and one pale stone minaret. Coarse original geometric rosettes suggest the painted façade rhythm;no historic floral art,calligraphy or photo pixels are copied. No furnished interior,detached tomb,fountain,planting or courtyard wall is included.
